outcomes.name: Understanding of the change impact assessment has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The change impact assessment is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Planning & Risk is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the change impact assessment.
Identify why the change impact assessment hasn't landed consistently for Planning & Risk in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the change impact assessment for Planning & Risk.
Confirm the change impact assessment for Planning & Risk is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Planning & Risk regularly to ensure the change impact assessment stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how People Experience & Culture has been affected by inconsistent change impact assessment since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific People Experience & Culture-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen People Experience & Culture in teams/sites where the change impact assessment is weakest.
Confirm People Experience & Culture has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on People Experience & Culture so gaps in the change impact assessment are caught early in future.
